# Specification fixtures

CommonMark specification examples by John MacFarlane and contributors, and GitHub Flavored Markdown specification examples adapted by GitHub and contributors. Licensed under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). These third-party fixtures retain that license, independently of the SDK license.

Sources, immutable version identifiers and hashes are recorded in manifest.json. The GFM spec.txt examples were extracted to JSON and visible tab arrows restored to tab characters. No expected result was changed. CommonMark JSON is unmodified. Raw parser expectations precede product sanitization and visual enhancements.
